signal: Digitate was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape Worldwide AIOps 2026 assessment and shipped autonomous AI agents in ignio

email.body1:
Ryo, saw Digitate was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape for AIOps and shipped autonomous AI agents in ignio.

Analyst recognition like that usually drives a spike in in-market accounts faster than the team can personally cover them, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Digitate off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryo, quick follow-up for Digitate.

After a Leader placement, demand jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to convert that attention, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Digitate needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ryo, last bit of proof for Digitate.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Digitate's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise AIOps vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryo, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Riding a wave of analyst attention is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Digitate either way.
